Lucas — attaching the requested packet for Fordham's evaluation. Summary answers follow; files are attached to this message.

1) SAST / DAST
- SAST: We run nightly static analysis across our monorepo via a mix of internal linters and commercial engines (Semgrep + vendor scanners). Findings are triaged by engineering squads; critical/high issues open a P0 and are routed to the owner immediately.
- DAST: Quarterly authenticated DAST scans for the hosted control plane and monthly unauthenticated scans for public endpoints. High-severity findings from DAST trigger an incident ticket and verification scan within 72 hours. We also run targeted DAST for major feature rollouts.
- Ownership: Security Engineering owns policy and gating; Application teams own fixes. We retain scan results for 12 months.

2) Patch SLAs (general guidance, applied per deployment mode)
- Critical (RCE, active exploit, CVSS >=9.0): remediate and deploy within 48–72 hours; hotfix path available for Hosted customers; rollback plan required for all critical deploys.
- High: remediate within 7 calendar days; verification within 14 days.
- Medium/Low: standard release window (next scheduled sprint/release) with prioritization guidance from Security.
- Verification: automated regression suites + post-deploy vulnerability scans. Our change runbook includes rollback criteria and emergency rollback steps.

3) Pen-test summary
- Attached: pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (executive summary; vendor-validated remediations). Scope: control plane, public APIs, auth flows.

4) SBOM snapshot
- Attached: redwood_sbom_snapshot_20270322.csv (runtime components, versions, licenses, hashes). We can provide continuous SBOM exports on agreed cadence as part of Private deployments.

5) Evidence & attestations
- SOC2 Type II and relevant sections of our security assessment are available on request (link included).

If you'd like a short mutual action plan, proposed owners, and dates I can attach a one-page MAP for procurement to consume.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
